svg.title: RescuePulse three-mode traffic light state machine
svg.desc: A three-lane traffic light array sits beside three state machine mode cards and the detection message that drives them. On a twenty-four second loop the left lane runs eight seconds green then two seconds yellow, the centre lane takes over, a siren is detected on the right, every lane drops to red for the two second clearance phase, then the right lane is held green indefinitely in emergency mode. After ten seconds without a siren all lanes return to red and the normal cycle resumes. A dashed fast path shows the clearance being skipped, and a timeline strip marks every phase against its real duration.
svg.text: Three-lane state machine · 9 GPIO lamps · NORMAL → CLEARANCE → EMERGENCY · timings to scale
WHEN THE SIREN LANE IS ALREADY GREEN AND NOT YELLOW
RECEIVED ONLY WHEN siren_active IS TRUE
A FALSE MESSAGE NEVER RESETS THE 10 s TIMEOUT CLOCK
LOOP TIMELINE · 24 s CYCLE · SEGMENTS DRAWN TO REAL DURATION
